meta.title: Metaphysics Charts (Xuanxue)
meta.description: Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) — eighteen systems in one plugin: eight chart systems plus ten quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis). Chart systems: BaZi (hidden stems, ten gods, 12 stages, 42 shensha, strength, pattern and useful-god, luck scoring), Zi Wei Dou Shu (49 stars with brightness, four 12-god cycles, 34 patterns, decade and annual/monthly/daily/hourly mutagen), LiuYao, MeiHua YiShu, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia (three ju-selection schools), compatibility charts (BaZi and Zi Wei), and Tarot, plus an ask-driven interpretation layer. Computed locally with networking off by default, exposed as an agent tool with a Web panel.
